title: 'Kids As Young As 15 On Pakistan's Target': Inside The Deadly PoK Protests
summary_full: In the last two months, over 100 people have been killed across the Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (PoK) in clashes between security officials and protesters led by the Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC)
